question: Consider the equation \(\sin\theta=\dfrac{a^2+b^2+c^2}{ab+bc+ca}\), where \(a,b,c\) are fixed nonzero real numbers. This equation has a solution for \(\theta\)

options.C: if and only if \(a,b,c\) all lie in the interval \((-1,1)\)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
